EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}This place is always so neat and
tidy{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} They must have a secret army
of cleaning people or something.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Esta zona del pueblo siempre está
como los chorros del oro{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿Será que tienen un ejército
secreto que lo limpia todo
cuando nadie mira?{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Qué movida{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Cette rue commerçante est toujours
impec{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}C'est probablement l'œuvre
d'un clan d'ninjas du nettoyage...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Questo posto è sempre così pulito
e ordinato{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}} Dovrei farmi dare
il numero dell'impresa di pulizie!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Rien à voir avec faire du shopping
dans une grande ville{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} L'ambiance
est bien plus sereine par ici !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Irgendwie hat's was, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}in 'ner kleinen
Stadt einkaufen zu gehen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hier
isses ruhig und keiner stresst!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hala, aquí estoy, con legañas
y todo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡lista para hacer mis
compras,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mi meraviglio di me stessa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} A
quest'ora già in piedi! Beh, per fare
compere si può fare,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Whoa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Evening already!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} I probably
should have gotten started a bit
earlier today,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Vaya!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Ya es de noche!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Eso me
pasa por no haber madrugado
un poquitín más,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh no!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} È già sera!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Avrei dovuto
cominciare la giornata un po' prima,
forse,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oha!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Akşam oluvermiş!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Bugün biraz
daha erken başlasaydım iyiymiş,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Look at the time!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} There's just
never enough time to get all my
shopping done, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me encanta darme un garbeo por la
zona comercial a estas horas. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}¡Creo
que hasta tiene otro ambientillo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Plutôt calme, la rue commerçante
à c't'heure-ci...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ça change de l'effervescence qui y
règne en pleine journée,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tutta questa tranquillità in città
è quasi inquietante, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
Beh, vista l'ora, non mi sorprende!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich bin gern um die Uhrzeit hier
unterwegs.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Viel weniger Leute, die
einem im Weg stehen,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aaa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Saate bak!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Alışverişin hepsini
yetiştirmeye gün yetmiyor resmen,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I love staying up late so much, you
could say my secret power is pulling
all-nighters!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Course that probably goes for 
anyone who's out and about at this
hour! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}A mí lo que me gusta es irme a
dormir a las tantas. ¡De noche todo
parece distinto!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Sobre todo la gente, claro. ¡Anda,
que menuda fauna se encuentra a
esas horas, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Chuis si balèze pour veiller tard
qu'on pourrait croire qu'c'est mon
super-pouvoir !
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Mais chuis pas la seule. C'est valable
pour tous ceux qui mettent le nez
dehors aussi tard,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sono del tutto a mio agio nelle ore
notturne. Quello che mi viene
meglio? Ovvio, fare nottata!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Immagino che sia così per chiunque
se ne va ancora in giro a quest'ora!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Wenn ich die Nacht durchmache,
bin ich voller Energie{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Tagsüber
bin ich nich' halb so energetisch!
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Aber so geht's wohl allen, die
um die Uhrzeit noch draußen
rumhängen! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Geç saatlere kadar ayakta kalmayı o
kadar seviyorum ki, süper gücüm
uykusuz kalmak olabilir!{{TAG:0003:0023:}} Tabii bu
saatte dışarıda olan herkes için aynı
şey söylenebilir! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Con un tiempo tan bonito, contaba
con que habría más gente{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Pero
tendrán mejores cosas que hacer...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bueno, ellos sabrán. ¡Así estamos
más tranquil{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}s tú y yo,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Vu l'temps, j'pensais qu'y allait y
avoir foule{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Faut croire qu'les gens
ont mieux à faire !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bah, c'est pas plus mal.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ça nous
laisse plus de chances de tomber
sur une belle affaire,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Con questo bel tempo, dove saranno
finiti tutti quanti?{{TAG:0003:0000:}} Beh, forse hanno
di meglio da fare.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sarà, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}It's real convenient how close the
shopping district is to the station!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's crack-a-lackin' up in here!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}C'est pratique que les commerces
soient si proches d'la gare !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tu
m'étonnes qu'ils fassent du chiffre !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I negozi sono talmente vicini alla
stazione che non mi sorprende che
qui ci sia sempre un gran {{TAG:0003:0025:}}caos!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}So praktisch, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dass die Einkaufs-
meile so nah am Bahnhof ist.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Kein
Wunder,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} dass hier so viel los is'!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Le luci in questa zona non sono
male per niente! Meglio ancora
quando si riflettono...
... sul bianco della neve,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I'm a night owl, so I'm often rushing
into stores right when they're about
to close{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I got major respect for those clerks
who help me out even when they're
trying to go home, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Con eso de que hago mi vida por las
noches, siempre me olvido de que
las tiendas tienen otro horario{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ay, y qué majos los empleados, que
me echan una mano aunque estén
deseando cerrar para marcharse.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}, j'vis la nuit, donc y
m'arrive souvent de débouler dans
les boutiques à la fermeture{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'admire tous ces employés qui
gardent le sourire alors qu'ils ont
qu'une envie : rentrer chez eux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Sono una creatura della notte, io!
Spesso entro nei negozi appena
prima dell'orario di chiusura{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ammiro il personale che rimane lì
ad aiutarmi, anche se non vede l'ora
di andare a casa, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ben gece kuşuyum; dükkânlar tam
kapanırken içeri daldığım çok olur{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Eve gitmeye hazırlanırken bile bana
yardım eden çalışanlara büyük saygım
var, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
